description: A failing GitHub Actions check on its second run attempt (runAttempt: 2) with an otherwise clean branch (not BEHIND or CONFLICTS) and no other actionable work. Shepherd's single rerun allowance was already consumed by attempt 1, and a clean branch offers no branch-refresh path either, so this is the bespoke 'single rerun allowance exhausted' escalate variant rather than the ordinary check-follow-up-unavailable text.
